title: Major Murphy tells Vallée about 1943 saucers and their psychotronic effect

tellings.quote: And he points to 1943 and he says, "You know, what if someone was experimenting with this technology? It turns out its real advantage wasn't its flight capabilities, but its psychotronic effect."

plain: A man called Major Murphy is said to have told the researcher Jacques Vallée that flying saucers went back to 1943, and to have asked what if someone was already experimenting with the technology then, adding that "its real advantage wasn't its flight capabilities, but its psychotronic effect," meaning its power over people's minds. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this from Vallée's book Messengers of Deception, as a hint that the phenomenon may have been a human tool of mind control.
